params.pretransferred: Integrating-contract flag only. The caller must transfer and consume atomically; staged use is at integrator risk with no ownership or timing guarantee. Callers with no bytecode revert `EOAPretransferNotAllowed()`. Unrecorded balance across transactions may be consumed by the next contract caller. Booked holder backing is never pretransfer credit.
